steps.name: Tech Team

studio.note: We are a five-person senior studio in Cairo. Founders take a product from a fixed-scope launch to a monthly technical team.

team.heading: Who you’ll [light]work with[/light]
team.lead: A five-person senior studio in Cairo. You work with the founders.

process.heading: Four phases, [light]no surprises[/light]
process.lead: Discovery, then Architecture and Build as the launch, then Launch & Care as a monthly tech team. Small team, short loops, a demo every Friday.
process.label: How we work · Four phases, no surprises

phases.name: Discovery
phases.description: About two weeks, at a fixed price. It ends in a launch plan: what to build, in what order, and what the launch has to survive.

phases.name: Architecture
phases.description: The launch plan becomes architecture. Information structure, systems and a prototype, decided before the build is locked.

phases.name: Build
phases.description: The fixed-scope build to production. Short cycles, a demo you can click, and a release rather than a status doc.

phases.name: Launch & Care
phases.description: After launch, a monthly retainer. We stay on as your tech team: features, infrastructure, on-call and AI.
